Guide receipt has separate won-valued credit cells for pension savings/retirement and ordinary/disabled insurance. Rule15 discards sub-won fractions of amounts entered in those cells. For nonnegative exact rational raw and cap, floor(min(raw,cap)) = min(floor(raw),floor(cap)). Flooring each side before min gives identical final won credit. No alleged one-won counterexample exists from this transformation.
